siblings.title: Tariff impact on margins
turns: How do the new tariffs hit us?

I worked it through against the landed-cost model. The Section 301 tariff adds 25% to landed cost on the Shenzhen SKUs, which drops gross margin on that line from 41% to 33%. The other two lines are unaffected because they ship from Vietnam.
Is that before or after the freight change?
Before. That 33% figure holds freight at the old rate, so it is the optimistic case.

siblings.title: Freight and logistics planning
turns: What did we land on for Q3 freight?
The approved Q3 freight budget is 48000 dollars, split 60/40 between ocean and air. Ocean is the bulk of it; air is reserved for the two SKUs that stock out fastest.
The main risk is a peak-season surcharge in September, which we have not budgeted for.

siblings.title: Competitor pricing scan
turns: What did the scan turn up?
Acme cut their list price by 8% in July. Globex held steady. Neither has announced a tariff surcharge yet.
No public explanation. It coincided with their new distribution deal.
